title: Inference Equivalence and Quotient Coding
abstract: arXiv:2611.21096v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Incomplete observations can admit multiple physical interpretations without making every task conclusion ambiguous. Recovering all compatible scenes is often unnecessary, whereas indiscriminate compression may change which claims are justified. We ask which distinctions among observation-compatible interpretation sets must be retained to preserve every valid conclusion of a specified task. We first define inference validity as truth across all physically compatible states and characterize it, under a closedness condition, by distances to physically realizable falsifying measurements. For a finite semantic claim family ordered by specificity, the Exact Inference Frontier forms the unique minimal antichain generating all valid claims. translated_abstract: 不完整的观测可以允许多种物理解释，而不致使每一项任务结论都变得含糊。恢复所有兼容的场景往往并无必要，而不加区分的压缩则可能改变哪些论断是有依据的。我们提出的问题是：为了保留某一指定任务的全部有效结论，在观测兼容的解释集合之间必须保留哪些区分。我们首先将推理有效性定义为在所有物理兼容状态下均为真，并在一个封闭性条件下，通过其到物理可实现的反驳性测量的距离来加以刻画。对于一个按具体性排序的有限语义论断族，精确推理前沿构成生成所有有效论断的唯一极小反链。随后我们定义兼容性集合之间的推理等价，并由它们的前沿构造出一个规范的商编码。在允许精确推理解码的确定性编码之中，该编码诱导出最粗的编码。
tldr: 该论文提出推理等价与商编码框架，证明按具体性排序的语义论断族的“精确推理前沿”是生成全部有效结论的唯一极小反链，并据此构造出在保留所有有效推理结论前提下区分最少的规范商编码。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes inference equivalence and a canonical quotient code, proving that the Exact Inference Frontier—the unique minimal antichain of a specificity-ordered claim family—generates all valid claims and induces the coarsest code that preserves exact inference.
